invariants.anchor: Normal warm-up reads only the compact Completion Record; the detailed report is read on demand
invariants.summary: Phase completion reports stay out of the default read set
The context compiler loads the prior compact Completion Record, not the full completion report
Each completed phase has one canonical phase completion report path

invariants.anchor: Do not create one completion file per routine task
invariants.summary: Routine tasks do not create separate completion-report files
Completion Record remains a compact cross-phase bridge

invariants.anchor: Each durable rule/fact gets one canonical owner
invariants.summary: Brief, Architecture and ADR remain canonical truth; completion reports are historical detail, not competing sources of truth

invariants.anchor: legacy completed phase whose durable history exists only in its `Completion Record` remains valid
invariants.summary: Legacy projects without separate completion reports remain valid
Framework updates preserve project-owned completion reports

invariants.anchor: Volatile hot context. Overwrite this file on each meaningful handoff
invariants.summary: NEXT_SESSION remains volatile hot navigation rather than durable history

invariants.anchor: personal repo router exceeds 3600-char hard budget
invariants.summary: Completion-report functionality must not justify increasing always-loaded token budgets

invariants.anchor: Human explanatory assets are source-only documentation and must never be required for Runtime operation or packaged into Project Runtime.
invariants.summary: Human visual explanations stay Framework Source-only and never become a Runtime dependency

invariants.anchor: One handoff prompt = one unresolved execution target.
invariants.summary: NEXT_SESSION_PROMPT never bundles unfinished current work with later queued work

invariants.anchor: Project-domain vocabulary belongs in the **Project Brief**
invariants.summary: Project-domain language stays compact in the existing Brief context instead of creating a parallel glossary or another default read
